# ParticleAnimationTiming

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Particles` · enum

```csharp
public enum ParticleAnimationTiming
```

How an [`AnimatedSpriteParticleRenderer`](AnimatedSpriteParticleRenderer.md) times its animation.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="overlife"></a>`OverLife` | One pass of the animation over each particle's life, for example smoke that puffs out and dissipates. |
| <a name="loop"></a>`Loop` | The animation at its own [`SpriteAnimation.FramesPerSecond`](SpriteAnimation.md#framespersecond) from the particle's age, for example a spinning coin. The animation's playback (loop, once, ping-pong) applies as usual. |
